title: Executive Chef
description:
Join our upscale restaurant as an Executive Chef. Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee all kitchen operations, including food preparation, cooking, and plating.
- Design innovative and seasonal menus.
- Manage kitchen staff, including hiring, training, and scheduling.
- Ensure strict compliance with health and safety regulations.
Requirements:
- Culinary degree or equivalent professional training.
- Extensive experience as a Head Chef or Executive Chef.
- Strong leadership and kitchen management skills.
- Passion for culinary excellence and creativity.
